newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks close lower on blue chip declines.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks close lower on blue chip declines.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed slightly lower on Tuesday due to declines in two highly capitalised blue chips, brokers said.
The all share index closed 1.2 points down at 620.1. Price declines led gains by 19 to 17. John Keells Holdings Ltd fell four rupees to 190, Lanka Orix Leasing Ltd one rupee to 151.
"Declines in JKH and LOLC were due to retail activity," said Hussain Gani, a trader at brokerage John Keells.
Many local retail investors and a few local institutions were active among finance and manufacturing sector stocks, which had seen good growth in 1996, he said.
